description: One Parboil D3Q19 LDC stream/collide step on the minimum 3x3x3 grid with one fluid cell.

pinned_source.license: Illinois Open Source License, University of Illinois/NCSA; complete text is reproduced in LICENSE.txt.

contract.operation: Initialize a 3x3x3 D3Q19 LDC grid, replace the center populations from input, then perform one source-ordered stream/collide pass.
contract.input_layout: Center-cell populations in source enum order C,N,S,E,W,T,B,NE,NW,SE,SW,NT,NB,ST,SB,ET,EB,WT,WB.
contract.population_encoding: Nonnegative signed-i64 fixed-point units of 1e-6; each entry is decoded to binary32 by f32(f32(raw)/f32(1000000)).
contract.boundary: Any cell on a grid face is an LDC obstacle. The center is the sole fluid cell; source acceleration is inactive for this geometry.
contract.source_order: Visit z, then y, then x; x is fastest. For fluid cells compute rho, ux, uy, uz, u2, and collision populations in source order, then push q to its direction neighbor. For obstacle cells push the opposite source population to the q-direction neighbor. Destination is initialized to equilibrium weights before the one step.
contract.arithmetic: Population and moment operations are binary32 in source order. DFL1/DFL2/DFL3 are unsuffixed double literals; equilibrium multiplication and the addition to the binary32 base are binary64, then the destination store rounds to binary32. The profile assumes IEEE round-to-nearest, with no reassociation or contraction; the pinned source does not specify compiler floating-point flags.
contract.projection: Sum over active destination cells and q of (cell_index+1)*round_away(f32(population*f32(1000000))), with cell_index=x+3*y+9*z.
contract.source_scope: One bounded LDC time step only; no file input, channel boundary handling, full-grid initialization pass, or timing wrapper.

input.encoding: Nineteen nonnegative center-cell D3Q19 populations in fixed-point units of 1e-6.

output.encoding: Weighted fixed-point checksum of all 513 active destination populations after one step.
